data.name: Dipan
data.gender_notes: Dipan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dipan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dip' which means 'luminous' or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Indra, the god of rain, thunder, and lightning. Dipan is also a name of the sun god, Surya. Therefore, the name symbolizes light, brilliance, and wisdom. The name Dipan carries the meaning “Luminous, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dipan usually hope their child will grow to embody luminous, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dipan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Luminous, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dipan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
